findings.finding: JWKS freshness subtracted Age after capping max-age, making legitimate aged responses prematurely stale.

findings.finding: Oversized numeric max-age and Age each became Infinity; subtraction produced NaN expiry, so keys could remain cached indefinitely.

findings.finding: Nodemailer10.0.16 maxResponseSize is not a strict64KiB cap on completed SMTP replies: a terminating line/chunk bypasses the partial-response length check.
findings.fix: An application-owned Duplex forwards at most 262144 inbound wire bytes over the entire send, including TLS handshake, and destroys the raw socket on overflow. The separate vendor65536-byte partial-response guard is documented accurately.
regressionEvidence: Auth focused r5 passes 148/148 including the actual socket exact262144-byte budget and next-byte peer EOF. Local application integration r3 passes55/55 including implicit TLS, STARTTLS and post-DATA cancellation.
findings.reviewerResult: Approved with narrow documented callback type assertion; strict64KiB completed-reply claim remains expressly excluded.

findings.finding: The bounded Google JWK projection stripped optional key_ops before passing the key to JOSE, making encryption-only declared keys usable for signature verification.
findings.fix: Optional key_ops is preserved and accepts exactly one verify operation; malformed/incompatible operations and RSA private fields fail closed.
regressionEvidence: Independent real signed-key fixture rejects encryption-only key_ops after the projection; focused auth also rejects private RSA fields. Strict unmatched Cache-Control quotes fail closed in2 independent cases.
findings.reviewerResult: Approved; independent auth-r2 passes11/11, including the named regression.

findings.finding: Child auth scopes inherited abort events but reset their monotonic expiration. If the parent timer is delayed, a continuation could admit child network work after the original operation deadline.
findings.fix: Child monotonic expiry is clamped to every known parent expiry; timer delay uses that same absolute expiry. Shared JWKS I/O retains its separate five-second shared-fetch budget.
regressionEvidence: Independent monotonic clock probe advances beyond parent deadline without firing its timer; child checkpoint rejects. Focused transport test and inherited-expiry admission fences also pass.
findings.reviewerResult: Approved; independent auth-r2 passes11/11, including the named regression.
